aheadSummary: The union calendar (lakeunion.org) has 15 listings for April–September 2027, mostly committees (8 left out, 7 kept); two more union items appear only on the Michigan calendar. In all 9 events, of which 2 are union-run (Hispanic Leadership Summit 11 Apr, Secondary Leadership Retreat 30 Sep–3 Oct at Camp Au Sable); the rest are division (NAD) or ASI events shown on the union calendar: SONscreen 8–10 Apr, Health Summit Intensive 9–11 Apr, NAD PBE finals 23–24 Apr (Huntsville), ASI Lake Union 23–24 Apr, CALLED pastors' family convention 21–24 Jun (Lexington KY), ASI convention 4–7 Aug (Orlando), plus the presidents' retreat (internal). No union camporee, youth congress, ministers' meeting or union-wide evangelism series is dated in the window; the next youth congress is Feb 2028 and the union camporee was Sep 2026.
countsBasis: In this union file the conferenceRun fields count union-run events (level union, not internal); division, ASI and other events shown on the union calendar are counted under otherLevels.
excludedNote: Holidays, office closures, payroll/treasury closes, audits, merchandise, committees, boards and ADCOM are left out (counted under excludedFromCalendar).
